Subject: Follow-up from discovery — next steps

Jasmine,

Thanks again for the quick discovery today — helpful to see Redwood's latency/edge story and the caching approach. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost on batch workloads while keeping sub-200ms P95 for critical paths.
- Stakeholders to include for the intro: Priya (product), Aman (platform), and our infra SME (Tina).

We'd like a 30-minute product intro/demo next week to see the platform end-to-end and validate the integration pattern. Can you propose 2–3 windows that work for your team (our timezone: PDT)? If possible, include an agenda and who from Redwood will be on the call (product vs SE). Also let us know if there's any quick pre-demo material we should review — especially around private deployment and audit logs.

Thanks — looking to lock something early in the week.

— Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Head of Integrations, OrbitLane
sanjay@orbitlane.co
